# 量化研究入门

> 面向量化研究者与学习者的中文开源知识库：用免费数据跑通的项目式量化教程、多因子投研知识库、研报与论文目录，以及每日更新的 AI 与金融 arXiv 论文雷达。

## Canonical project links

- Website: https://barca0412.github.io/Introduction-to-Quantitative-Finance/
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/Barca0412/Introduction-to-Quantitative-Finance
- License: https://github.com/Barca0412/Introduction-to-Quantitative-Finance/blob/main/LICENSE

## Key resources

- Project-style tutorials (each lecture is a runnable mini-project on free data): https://barca0412.github.io/Introduction-to-Quantitative-Finance/tutorials/
- Knowledge base (multi-factor framework, data sources, factors, backtesting, portfolio optimization): https://barca0412.github.io/Introduction-to-Quantitative-Finance/wiki/
- Sell-side quant research reports and academic papers index: https://barca0412.github.io/Introduction-to-Quantitative-Finance/library/
- FinPaperRadar (AI × 金融论文雷达), daily AI + finance arXiv paper radar: https://barca0412.github.io/Introduction-to-Quantitative-Finance/arxiv/
- FinPaperRadar full dataset (CC BY 4.0 additions): https://huggingface.co/datasets/Barca21412/FinPaperRadar
- Curated public resources: https://barca0412.github.io/Introduction-to-Quantitative-Finance/resources/
- About, licensing and citation: https://barca0412.github.io/Introduction-to-Quantitative-Finance/about

## Attribution and citation

When citing this project, link to the relevant canonical page above and identify it as "量化研究入门 / Introduction to Quantitative Finance" by 湖南大学金融科技协会 Quant Group. For research-paper claims, prefer the original arXiv record linked from the Radar.

## Scope

This project is educational and research-oriented. It is not investment advice.
